metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a dawn written at a dawn, three candles against one, Titus, and thirty-eight shillings.

yesterday: The sheet runs to the nurse. They parted at sunrise. There were rooks. The candle was at the socket.
She counted three on Tuesday and one this morning. Tuesday was the tooth. The lovers were today.
The cloves stand at two pence, entered once. Twelve pence is still Tuesday's.
The share is thirty-eight shillings. Last week was forty-five. You were in Titus. The king was Tuesday. The glass is locked.
Three leaves are under the account book. The jaw is not quiet. Tomorrow is a soft day if she has her way, and the tooth is still in.
